# Advent of Code

> > An annual programming challenge event featuring daily coding puzzles released in an advent calendar format throughout December.

Advent of Code presents algorithmic and computational puzzles of varying difficulty levels that can be solved in any programming language. Each year features a new set of 25 challenges released daily from December 1st through December 25th, with participants competing on leaderboards and sharing solutions across the global programming community.

## Key Topics

- Advent of Code
- Programming challenges
- Coding puzzles
- Algorithm problems
- Advent calendar format
- Daily puzzles
- Competitive programming
- Problem solving
- Leaderboards
- December coding event
- Multi-language support
- 2025 edition
